selection: OOF pooled discovery at floor(N/3), then AP, then frozen candidate order compact/rich, no separation/separation, logistic/histogram; smaller grid first
estimand: Delta20 = 20*(D_logistic_MZ-D_logistic_M)/N among source-normal held-out families at 10%; primary k=floor(N/3), secondary floor(N/4)
banks: E selected conventional bank; B adds total4; L2 adds endpoints; L6 adds exactly Z6; N=B+norm-product proxy6; NZ=N+Z; M=N+four-layer w/g L2 and marginal last/mean/SD+shared bias6; MZ=M+Z. No layer-share slopes in this study
measurement_definitions: Identical to 20261121_structural01: signed float32 mean gradients then absolute weight products; float64 CPU marginals absmean/signed population SD/absolute median/q90; U=L2(w)*L2(g), proxy denominator sum of four U+epsilon; bias excluded from weight totals; original stabiliser validity
telemetry: Original compact/rich ordinary source telemetry, coordinate GNS up to4096, fixed microbatch128, class probability clustering k=2/3 positive silhouette >=5 examples/cluster. Means/SD population; slopes actual full-horizon fraction. Saturation at1%. Missing correct-only confidence stays missing, fold-local imputation; nonfinite required loss/gradient/share measurements invalid
panel_rule: A primary; frozen A on B and B-development refit with A-selected hyperparameters only; no B selection
bootstrap_rule: 5000 paired draws of all32 evaluation setting families, nested runs together, recompute N/k/ranks with occurrence IDs; empty/single-label draws invalid and counted; percentile pointwise intervals conditional on frozen forecasters, not model selection or simultaneous curves
gate: Implementation/preservation/boundary pass; evaluation support pass; primary Delta20>=1 and lower95CI>0; MZ discovery greater than matched logistic B and development-selected strongest non-Z E/B/N/M; both B variants positive MZ-M; no family omission has negative primary difference
limitations: Fresh configurations share MNIST and common outcome images; history-informed capacity, within-benchmark validation only. 60epochs is not a previously validated health solution. Missing prediction depth and incomplete reproductions of related systems remain limitations. No economic savings or causal shortcut mechanism claimed
readiness_rule: All128 planned development classifiers reach complete/diverged status, no incomplete; source-normal support20 each/8families each plus valid five- or three-fold family CV. No predictor-advantage criterion; fail stops evaluation without design expansion
capacity_history: One-third chosen from consumed pilot diagnostics; new outcomes untouched
